Ivy Chen: hey team — quick Notion onboarding Q: where do folks put canonical onboarding pages vs personal starter checklists? also who owns the 'Eng Starter Checklist' template so I can request edit rights? @DocOps
Marcus Green: welcome Ivy! Canonical onboarding lives in Company Wiki > Docs Library > Teams > Eng > Onboarding. Starter checklists are under Company Wiki > Templates > New Hire Toolkit > Eng. If it's just for your ramp, duplicate to My Workspace. If you need source edits, request owner access.
Priya Patel: owners are shown in the template header (top-right). Example: Owner: eng-docs@redwood. If it's empty, add a page comment like "@TeamDocs can you advise owner?" and we'll pick it up.
Ivy Chen: sweet. is there a quick slack command to request edit access (don't want to open the full form while I'm on my laptop setup)
Lena Wu: yup — two options: 1) quick Slack snippet for urgent requests, 2) formal form for audit. Quick snippet (paste in #devex):
```
@DocOps request-edit https://notion.redwood.company/Company/Templates/Eng/Eng-Starter-Checklist --reason "add infra sandbox steps" --cc @Marcus
```
That creates a ticket and notifies the rotation.
DocOps: Auto-reply: Ticket DOC-9452 created for Ivy Chen -> Eng-Starter-Checklist. Assigned: Docs (Eng) queue. ETA: 1 business day.
Marcus Green: PSA: when you duplicate a canonical page, keep a small banner at the top: "Derived from Eng Starter Checklist v1.2 — do not edit source." helps us later when we consolidate changes. :thumbsup:
Ivy Chen: filed the snippet, got the ticket. one more Q: recommended 30/60/90 or 1:1 templates for IC engineers?
Priya Patel: Templates > New Hire Toolkit has Eng 1:1 Agenda and Eng 30/60/90. There are manager-facing and IC-facing variants. Duplicate the IC version and rename "Ivy Chen - 30/60/90" then share with your manager.
Ivy Chen: if I edit my duplicate and want to propose canonical updates, what's the preferred workflow?
Lena Wu: keep edits in your duplicate, add a "Proposed canonical edits" section with bullets, then comment on the source template with a short summary + link to your duplicate. Tag @eng-docs. For small changes owners can merge; bigger changes may go through the docs RFC.
DocOps: Note: canonical template changes require owner approval for audit trail. Ticket DOC-9452 updated: status -> pending owner review.
Ivy Chen: perfect, thanks everyone! saved me a headache during setup. :wave:
